semiconductor_relevance: High — EMP is a full-service distributor focused on the semiconductor industry, with a network of over 3,000 suppliers.
summary: European Market Partner BV (EMP) is a full-service distributor specializing in semiconductor systems and components. Established in 1991, EMP provides procurement services to source tools and parts globally, while also offering selling services for surplus spare parts. The company is committed to customer service, application knowledge, and efficient logistics within the semiconductor fabrication sector.
capabilities: Global procurement services for semiconductor tools and parts
Surplus spare parts administration and consignment services
